pages.title: Elemental Nodes
pages.text: Elemental Nodes embody the four classical elements—Water, Air, Fire, and Earth. They are created through $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual)Nature's Ritual$(/l) and serve as fundamental components in many Hexalia systems.

pages.title: On Creation
pages.text: Each node is formed by transmuting an Amethyst Shard alongside natural materials aligned with a specific element. The combination determines the resulting elemental aspect.

pages.title: Water Node
pages.text: Represents fluidity and life. Water Nodes are often used in effects tied to restoration, flow, and aquatic influence.

pages.title: Air Node
pages.text: Represents motion and lightness. Air Nodes are associated with speed, movement, and elevated effects.

pages.title: Fire Node
pages.text: Represents heat and transformation. Fire Nodes are tied to energy, combustion, and aggressive reactions.

pages.title: Earth Node
pages.text: Represents stability and growth. Earth Nodes are commonly linked to resilience, grounding, and natural strength.

pages.title: Tree Resin
pages.text: Tree Resin is a sticky substance harvested from certain trees using an $(l:hexalia:content/tools#athame)Athame$(/l). Extracting it will strip the log in the process.

pages.title: Uses of Resin
pages.text: Resin is used in brews, rituals, and crafting. It often acts as a binding or stabilizing component in more complex processes.

pages.title: Ancient Seed
pages.text: The Ancient Seed is a rare relic containing dormant life energy. It can be discovered within jungle structures and holds significant potential when used in ritual work.

pages.title: Potential
pages.text: Through $(l:hexalia:core_mechanics/natures_ritual)Nature's Ritual$(/l), the Ancient Seed can be transformed into powerful outcomes, making it a valuable find for those who uncover it.
